source.method: Read the immutable published GitHub commit through the Git API; its tree equals the clean local immutable tree. Every listed source binding was freshly read from that local Git tree and rehashed. No source, ref or ledger mutation by this review.

diagnosticPatch.scope: Seven existing files only: fixed optional startup observations, their bounded capture, and meaningful regression fixtures. The three additional CSS paths in the published tree are the separately reviewed exact bfd base delta.

reviewedBoundaries.finding: Only six fixed error categories and a finite code allowlist are admitted. The normalizer does not read message, stack, arbitrary name or path and does not invoke code getters. Strict plain-record parsing rejects extra own keys at every nested marker/output level; throwing proxies, parse errors and observer/sink exceptions are contained.

The parser accepts only HARNESS_STARTUP_V1 markers, at most2048 bytes per line and32 retained events. Each stream hashes/parses only its first262144 bytes, then continues draining/counting. Receipts explicitly state prefix hash scope, limit, hashed bytes and truncation. Overlong/malformed/private lines are discarded. No arbitrary stdout/stderr contents are retained.

The first fixed failure is retained independently of the event cap, including renderer-gone with error:null. Later process error/exit/close observations remain separate and cannot replace that first failure. A failed optional clock yields null elapsedMs rather than throwing from a process lifecycle listener.

Existing token validation precedes backend error observation. Exact ready token/origin/PID admission,60-second deadline and original rejection survive throwing observers. The server uses a minimal local finite classifier rather than importing desktop code outside its packaged source closure. Its test-data-only fallback is owned stdout, preserving the original stderr tail and error/exit behavior.

Markers are test-data-only and fixed; marker wrapper/sink failures are swallowed. Existing app/backend/window readiness flow,20-second surface deadline, renderer recovery, sender/grant logic and cleanup remain. The startupSettled latch is set after screen registration so a later startup exception still emits a failure marker.

Output changes from ignored to piped and bounded metadata capture. Capture setup occurs inside the existing launch cleanup try. Constructor failure attaches drain handlers/resumes both pipes and reports capture-unavailable; it does not alter startup success or bypass cleanup. Existing45-second CDP readiness,80-second main-page discovery, nonce/executable/current-page checks, exact install/payload/native Save/readback and cleanup predicates are unchanged.

launchDiagnostics is additive metadata. The strict six-phase native Save event schema and exact helper463d remain unchanged. No flag, provider/account action, dependency, egress permission, timeout relaxation or installed-success substitute is introduced.

priorFailureBoundary.finding: Actual installed launch exited1 before a main-page candidate and before any memory action; installer, exact full payload and provider checks had passed. The19488ms readiness observation starts after CDP/owner verification, not at process creation. Existing output was ignored, so a source/environment cause was not established. This patch collects bounded observations; it does not claim to fix or explain that prior exit.

verdict: No remaining concrete correctness, privacy, ownership, bounded-work or packaging-closure defect found in the exact published diagnostics cut. Preserve the actual failure history and require new exact-source Windows execution; default-off retention, enabled installed memory and live quality/cost remain separate gates.
